hero.subtitle: Cashew Processing
hero.title: Chemical-Free Processing. Farm OS Documented.
hero.description: Every kernel we process is tracked in our Farm OS — from the block it was harvested to the processing batch, quality grade, and export container. Most processors send paperwork. We send proof.

roadmap.title: Processing Roadmap
roadmap.description: Three phases, one operating system. Every stage documented in Farm OS for full traceability — from pilot to regional processing hub.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Pilot
phase1.description: Small-batch, quality-first processing with Farm OS tracking at every stage.
points: Farm OS integration at every step

phase2.title: Phase 2: Industrial Expansion
phase2.description: Multi-line automated processing with regional supplier network and full certification compliance.

phase3.title: Phase 3: Processing Hub
phase3.description: Large-scale integrated processing hub serving West Africa and global export markets with full vertical integration.

phases.title: Our Processing Phases
phases.description: From pilot to industrial scale — every phase connected to our Farm OS for complete traceability and quality assurance.

phase1.title: Pilot Processing (2028-2030)
phase1.description: Our initial small-scale facility focuses on quality control, operational learning, and establishing market linkages with manual to semi-automated technology.

reception.title: Reception & Storage
reception.description: Raw nuts weighed, sampled, and logged in Farm OS with supplier batch ID and moisture readings.

steaming.title: Steaming & Roasting
steaming.description: Chemical-free steam processing. Temperature and duration recorded per batch in Farm OS.

shelling.title: Shelling
shelling.description: Manual and semi-automatic shelling with yield rates tracked per batch for quality optimization.

drying.title: Drying & Peeling
drying.description: Moisture levels monitored and logged. Each batch tracked to target specifications.

grading.title: Grading
grading.description: Size, color, and quality data entered per batch — building the dataset for AI-assisted grading in Phase 2.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.description: Vacuum sealed with nitrogen flush. Batch ID linked to packaging date, weight, and destination.

phase2.title: Industrial Scaling (2033+)
phase2.description: Full-scale processing with Farm OS integration at every stage — real-time monitoring, automated quality checks, and complete traceability.

reception.title: Automated Reception
reception.description: Digital intake with automated weighing, sampling, and silo storage — all data flowing directly into Farm OS.

steaming.title: Industrial Roasting
steaming.description: Continuous steam roasters with sensor data logged to Farm OS for quality consistency and energy optimization.

shelling.title: Mechanical Shelling
shelling.description: Semi-automated lines with real-time yield monitoring and dust extraction — performance metrics tracked per shift.

drying.title: Automated Drying
drying.description: Digital moisture sensors feeding data to Farm OS. Mechanical peeling with quality verification at each stage.

grading.title: Electronic Grading
grading.description: Optical sorters integrated with Farm OS. AI-assisted defect detection and automatic grade classification.

packaging.title: Automated Packaging
packaging.description: High-speed lines with checkweighers and label printers linked to Farm OS batch records and export documentation.

workflow.subtitle: Every step documented. Every batch traceable.

differentiators.title: What Sets Us Apart
differentiators.description: Most processors can tell you what they did. We can show you — with Farm OS data backing every claim.

quality.title: Data-Backed Quality
quality.description: Every quality check is logged digitally. Buyers receive batch-specific data, not generic certificates.

sustainability.title: Measurable Sustainability
sustainability.description: Water usage, waste diversion, and energy consumption tracked in Farm OS — not estimated, measured.

certifications.title: Audit-Ready Compliance
certifications.description: Our digital records create a continuous audit trail. When certifiers arrive, the data is already organized.

certifications.title: Our Certifications
certifications.description: We adhere to the highest international standards for quality, safety, and sustainability.

organic.title: Organic Certification
organic.description: Our farm is transitioning to organic practices from planting. Full organic certification requires 3 years of verified organic methods.

halal.title: Halal Certification
halal.description: Our processing facility will be designed to meet Halal standards from day one.

iso.title: ISO 22000
iso.description: Food safety management systems will be implemented during facility construction.

fairtrade.title: Fair Trade
fairtrade.description: We will pursue Fair Trade certification once our outgrower program is established.

sustainability.title: Sustainability Practices
sustainability.description: We design every stage of our processing to reduce waste, conserve resources, and use renewable energy.

water.title: Water Efficiency
water.description: Closed-loop recycling to minimize water usage.

waste.title: Waste Management
waste.description: Shell byproducts repurposed as fuel and biomaterials.

cta.title: Experience Farm OS-Tracked Quality
cta.description: Join us in revolutionizing African cashew processing with premium, certified, fully traceable products.

whyProcessLocal.title: Why We Process Cashews in Ivory Coast
benefits: Keep value in the country of origin — verified by export data
Create local jobs (100+ positions) — tracked in our HR system
Reduce shipping weight by 25% (shells removed at source)
Premium pricing for Farm OS-documented processed kernels

cnslRecovery.title: CNSL Recovery: Turning Waste Into Revenue
cnslRecovery.description: Cashew Nut Shell Liquid is a high-value byproduct. We track CNSL yield per batch in Farm OS — transforming a disposal cost into a documented profit center.

midCta.title: See the Facility Behind the Process
midCta.description: Explore the layout of our future processing center — every zone designed for efficiency, certification compliance, and Farm OS integration.

cnsl.title: CNSL: Turning Shell Waste Into Industrial Gold
cnsl.description: Cashew Nut Shell Liquid is a high-value byproduct extracted during processing. Instead of paying to dispose of shells, we sell CNSL to industries worldwide — transforming a cost into a profit center.

shellRecovery.title: 1. Shell Recovery
shellRecovery.description: During shelling, cashew shells are collected. 1 ton of raw nuts yields ~250kg of shells — all captured for processing.

extraction.title: 2. CNSL Extraction
extraction.description: Shells are pressed or solvent-extracted to yield CNSL — rich in cardanol and anacardic acid, prized industrial compounds.

revenue.title: 4. Revenue Impact
revenue.description: At full capacity, CNSL is projected to contribute 8-12% of total processing revenue — transforming a disposal cost into a profit center while achieving near-zero waste.

chemicalFree.title: 100% Chemical-Free Processing. Farm OS Verified.
chemicalFree.description: Unlike traditional methods that use chemicals to soften shells, our steaming process preserves organic integrity — and every batch is documented to prove it.

traditional.title: Traditional Method
traditional.description: Chemical soaking leaves residues, damages kernels, and creates hazardous waste — with paper records that are hard to verify.

afrinuts.title: The AfriNuts Method
afrinuts.description: Steam roasting. Zero chemicals. Every batch logged in Farm OS with temperature, duration, and operator ID.
afrinuts.point4: Safer conditions — documented in safety logs

bottomLine.title: Why It Matters for Buyers
bottomLine.description: Chemical-free processing means our kernels meet the strictest EU organic import standards. And because it's tracked in Farm OS, you don't have to take our word for it — you can verify it yourself.
